COMPLETE FOLLOW-THROUGH REQUEST — DO NOT LEAVE PRIOR OR NEW GAPS UNRESOLVED

This is the follow-through request after the latest #371/#372/#373/#374 campaign results. Treat ALL previous requirements, newly discovered roots, partials, blockers, and next steps as one reconciled worklist.

0. PRIMARY RULE

Do NOT stop at the latest reported success.

Re-read and reconcile:

- MASTER CONTINUATION — Independent verification #364–#369 + full execution #370 #371

- SUPPLEMENTARY DEEP ROOT-CAUSE CLOSEOUT — 330-point black/white/partial/load audit #372

- ENV-PREREQUISITES — Android API / CPU / ABI / hardware / software compatibility matrix #373

- BASE-ANDROID — Complete Android Platform Contract Foundation Audit #374

- current constitution/laws

- root_registry.json

- worklog/campaign state

- all posted evidence ledgers

- current source tree

- current HEAD

- existing historical evidence

Then derive one complete matrix:

DONE / VERIFIED / PARTIAL / BLOCKED / PENDING / UNKNOWN / DUPLICATE / SUPERSEDED.

Every incomplete item must either be implemented and verified, or be proven to require an external prerequisite and recorded as BLOCKED with evidence.

Do not create duplicate roots.

1. FIRST REPRODUCE CURRENT BASELINE

Before changing code:

- verify current remote HEAD

- verify current binary SHA

- verify source/build reproducibility

- run the recorded baseline gates

- verify anchors/goldens

- verify Gate A

- verify negatives

- verify reinstall/uninstall

- verify battery

- verify NATX 10/10 x3

- verify multi-app

- record any drift before debugging.

No regression may be hidden.

2. COMPLETE #374 — ANDROID BASE FOUNDATION

Execute the entire #374 98-section foundation contract, not merely its documentation.

For every domain prove:

SOURCE -> ANDROID LAW -> IMPLEMENTATION -> SYNTHETIC POSITIVE -> SYNTHETIC NEGATIVE -> REAL APK -> FIRST DIVERGENCE -> 3 RUNS -> REGRESSION.

Audit all previous #374 layers including:

- platform/device contract

- API/target-SDK behavior

- CPU/ABI/native/linker

- APK/package/install/update/splits/signing

- permissions/AppOps/special access

- UID/user/profile/sandbox/security

- filesystem/CE/DE/external/scoped storage/SAF/MediaStore

- Context/ContextImpl

- system services and boot/readiness ordering

- Binder/IPC identity

- lifecycle/process/application/provider startup

- Intent resolution/package visibility

- resources/configuration/overlays

- Looper/threading/memory

- Window/View/Display/IME/System UI

- Surface/BufferQueue/RenderThread/Skia/compositor/presentation/capture

- input routing

- network/netd/DNS/TLS/VPN

- media/audio/camera/sensors/location

- SQLite

- crypto/Keystore

- SELinux/MAC/security boundaries

- alarms/jobs/notifications/foreground/background policy

- backup/restore/clear-data/force-stop/reinstall/update

- accessibility/autofill/text services

- clipboard/share/chooser

- settings/system configuration

- widgets/shortcuts/launcher

- exceptions/ANR/watchdog

- observability

- corpus-derived discovery

- reference differential probes.

Do not count placeholders as VERIFIED.

3. CLOSE CURRENTLY KNOWN PARTIALS

R-NEW-464

Finish the Method-record reflection/getDeclaredMethods route deterministically.

- Do not use broad reflection hacks.

- Preserve declaring-class identity and method metadata.

- Verify getDeclaredMethods/getModifiers/getAnnotation and related Method semantics.

- Add focused synthetic probes and a real APK.

- 3 clean runs.

- Cross-match registry before adding any new root.

ViewPager / mCurItem

Resolve the primitive/field identity frontier if the APK is available and SHA-pinned.

- First establish exact APK identity.

- If current F-Droid artifact differs from recorded evidence, do NOT claim a runtime regression.

- Obtain/restore the exact evidence artifact through the existing reproducible corpus mechanism if available.

- Then reproduce and fix the generic law.

- No ViewPager-specific hack.

Compose family / F-NEW-221

Use sudokusolver and another independent Compose APK.

- determine the actual missing platform/runtime contract

- distinguish Compose infrastructure from app-specific code

- fix generic contract only

- verify fan-out on another Compose app.

Fragment materialization frontier

For ARM/native and mixed apps, separate:

ABI blocker

from

Fragment/component/lifecycle blocker.

Do not report a dual-cause without independent A/B evidence.

F-NEW-084 interpreter halt

Investigate the infinite-loop cap 50001.

- determine whether the interpreter loop is semantically legitimate, incorrectly bounded, or missing a runtime operation

- never simply raise/remove the cap to make the game pass

- add a bounded semantic execution law and regression probe

- test fairymahjong plus another game.

4. ENVIRONMENT / PREREQUISITE LAYER

Complete #373 into an operational preflight gate.

For every APK inspect:

- min/target/max SDK

- target-SDK behavior changes

- permissions + AppOps/special access

- features

- graphics requirements

- Vulkan/GLES requirements

- native ABIs per ELF

- DT_NEEDED dependency closure

- WebView

- media codecs

- camera/mic/location/sensors

- external dependencies

- splits

- required services.

Return:

AVAILABLE / PARTIAL / MISSING / INCOMPATIBLE / NOT_TESTED

and

REQUIRED / OPTIONAL / CONDITIONAL / IMPLIED / UNKNOWN.

The gate must run BEFORE ordinary runtime debugging.

5. CAPABILITY HONESTY

Audit every advertised capability against actual execution.

In particular:

- SUPPORTED_ABIS must not advertise non-executable ARM unless translation exists.

- Vulkan must not be advertised if only GLES2 exists.

- camera/GPS/telephony/BT/NFC must remain honestly absent unless implemented.

- permissions must not all become granted.

- services must not return fake success.

- Build.* and feature flags must match behavior.

- storage paths must correspond to real storage.

- native libraries must be executable, not merely extractable.

Produce a FALSE_ADVERTISED matrix and drive every false claim to zero or explicit documented limitation.

6. UNKNOWN APK GATE

Make the Agent Skill consume the same preflight contract.

For an unknown APK the skill must be able to answer:

- what is this package?

- what does it require?

- what can MiniAndroid provide?

- what is missing/incompatible?

Mandatory verdict:

7. CORPUS-DERIVED DISCOVERY

Do not rely only on the predefined foundation list.

8. NEW APP + NEW GAME ACCEPTANCE

After foundation changes test at least:

- 1 genuinely new independent-family app

For every candidate:

11. SECURITY / NEGATIVE TESTS

Prove denial semantics for:

- permissions

No universal root, universal permission, universal service or universal capability.

12. PERSISTENCE / INSTALLATION PROOF

APK -> component -> ViewTree -> draw op -> surface -> buffer -> compositor/presentation -> capture.

CONT-9 / WAVE 5 — Compose Continuation Root + External KB Runtime Fan-out

0. START HERE — DO NOT DECLARE SUCCESS FROM DOOZ FALLBACK

Current CONT-8 evidence is accepted only as a refined runtime frontier.

Dooz is NOT yet REAL_APP_CONTENT:

- F-NEW-260 is a hardcoded/source-grounded visual fallback.

- Its 25 draw ops are injected by C++.

- The fallback MUST be disabled/bypassed for compatibility verdicts.

- Do not use the fallback screenshot as proof of Compose compatibility.

- Keep it only as a SOURCE-GROUNDED VISUAL ORACLE.

Current refined Dooz frontier from CONT-8:

- AndroidComposeView draw path is healthy.

- Native View/ViewGroup ladder is color-exact and framebuffer-proven.

- Exactly one LayoutNode was inserted.

- One Composer + one Applier were created.

- UiApplier insertBottomUp and LayoutNode.insertAt each ran once.

- SubComposition did not materialize.

- Composition change recording stops mid-content-pass.

- First divergence is now classified as Compose continuation/change-application ordering, not Canvas/RenderNode/Layer routing.

- F-NEW-256 remains CLASSIFIED-REFINED; no generic fix has yet been attempted.

1. BASELINE FIRST

At the actual current remote main HEAD:

- Verify HEAD and binary SHA.

- Re-run the mandatory baseline gates.

- Re-run Dooz with F-NEW-260 disabled.

- Preserve the current CONT-8 anchor SHA and compare.

- Do not hide any regression.

If the reported remote HEAD differs from the locally assumed HEAD, stop and reconcile before modifying code.

2. PRIMARY ROOT — F-NEW-256 / COMPOSE CONTINUATION ORDERING

Investigate and fix the generic semantic law identified in CONT-8:

Initial composition continuation must not allow the Recomposer/apply continuation to consume a change list while the content lambda is still executing.

Prove the exact sequence in MiniAndroid:

- Composer creation

- Applier creation

- content lambda entry

- change recording

- continuation scheduling

- change-list application

- content lambda return

- Recomposer/apply continuation

- SubcomposeLayout/SubComposition creation

- UiApplier node insertion

- measure/layout/draw

Find the smallest generic divergence against the relevant AndroidX/Compose source behavior.

Required discipline:

SOURCE -> ALGORITHM -> SEMANTIC LAW -> CURRENT DIVERGENCE -> FIRST RUNTIME DIVERGENCE -> MINIMAL GENERIC FIX -> SYNTHETIC PROBE -> DOOZ REAL APK -> INDEPENDENT COMPOSE APK -> 3 RUNS -> REGRESSION.

Do NOT:

- special-case Dooz

- special-case R8 names such as Lt4/Lel0/Lv02

- add package-name conditionals

- patch LayoutNode/Canvas merely to make Dooz draw

- increase budgets to hide the issue

- keep or modify F-NEW-260 as the compatibility solution.

3. DOOZ ACCEPTANCE

After the generic fix, run original Dooz APK with fallback disabled.

Required proof:

install identity

Activity lifecycle

Composition

3 byte-identical runs

The screenshot must be produced by the actual APK/DEX Compose execution, not injected fallback operations.

The expected source-derived visual oracle may be used only for comparison/provenance, never as runtime content.

4. INDEPENDENT COMPOSE FAN-OUT

Use at least 2 independent Compose consumers:

- Sudoku/SudokuSolver (previously blocked Compose frontier)

- one additional independent Compose APK, preferably from the external Root KB or current corpus

For each:

- exact APK SHA

- preflight

- first divergence

- real Compose materialization

- actual content

- 3 runs

- whether the F-NEW-256 fix improves it without app-specific logic.

A fix that only makes Dooz work is NOT accepted as generic.

5. USE THE FRIEND'S EXTERNAL ROOT KNOWLEDGE BASE AS A SEARCHLIGHT

Canonical external snapshot:

SHA-256:

6. EXTERNAL KB FORENSIC -> RUNTIME FAN-OUT

7. INDEPENDENTLY TEST THE SIX-GAME CLAIM

- 2048

- mini-tetris

8. CONT-8 SUCCESS PATH MUST REMAIN GREEN

9. FISHRINGS LESSON — SCHEDULING, NOT BUDGET

Keep the proven finding:

Timer.schedule(5000ms) requires virtual-time advancement; increasing instruction budget is not the generic solution.

Use this as a model for the KB fan-out:

source -> semantic scheduling law -> runtime divergence -> minimal generic fix -> independent consumer -> 3-run proof.

10. ABI / PREFLIGHT RULE

Before runtime debugging of each new APK:

- inspect native ABIs and ELF dependency closure.

- x86/x86_64-native targets are the current runtime priority.

- ARM/ARM64-only APKs must be classified as environment/ABI blocked unless a translation path is independently proven.

Do not turn an ABI blocker into a runtime root.

11. REGISTRY DISCIPLINE

For every candidate:

13. DEFINITION OF DONE FOR THIS WAVE

Do not stop after saying “Dooz Compose root found.”

This wave is complete only when:

CONT-11 / WAVE 7 — Kotlin/stdlib semantic backend investigation + Compose draw frontier

0. PURPOSE

Do NOT assume the remaining Dooz/Compose blocker is “just another Kotlin root”.

The latest CONT-10 evidence proves two generic Kotlin/collection semantic failures:

- F-NEW-259: Kotlin ArrayDeque inherits Kotlin AbstractList.iterator(); MiniAndroid's host/shadow iterator resolved size()/get() by name only, so R8-renamed overrides were invisible.

- F-NEW-259b: java.util.ArrayList.addAll(Collection) was missing and silently became a no-op.

After those fixes, real Compose navigation materializes multiple LayoutNodes, but drawing still stops before framebuffer because the AndroidCanvas bridge is never constructed.

This wave must answer a larger question before adding many more handwritten roots:

Can MiniAndroid reuse an existing Kotlin/JVM/stdlib implementation, source-derived compatibility layer, host Java implementation, or other open-source runtime component to cover families of Kotlin collection/runtime semantics generically?

Do not guess. Research first, then prove the smallest reusable path experimentally.

1. BASELINE / CURRENT HEAD

Before changes:

- verify remote main HEAD

- verify binary SHA

- rebuild deterministically

- run CONT-10 baseline

- run Dooz fallback-disabled 3x

- preserve current Dooz anchor and opencalc/chess/microtimer/unote controls

- verify CONT-10 probes 7/7 and negatives 19/19

If HEAD differs from the assumed evidence lineage, reconcile first.

2. SOURCE-FIRST KOTLIN FORENSICS

Read the actual upstream sources for the pinned APK versions, not generic web summaries.

Required sources:

- Kotlin stdlib version actually present in target APKs

- kotlin.collections.AbstractList

- kotlin.collections.AbstractCollection

- kotlin.collections.ArrayDeque

- kotlin.collections.ArrayList

- Map/Set/HashMap/HashSet/LinkedHashMap/LinkedHashSet

- iterators/list iterators

- Collection/Iterable/Sequence operations

- array-to-collection conversion

- equals/hashCode/toArray contracts

- JVM-specific stdlib actualizations

- kotlinx.coroutines version actually present

- Continuation/CoroutineDispatcher/DispatchedContinuation/EventLoop/Flow/StateFlow/collect semantics

For every candidate, record:

SOURCE -> ALGORITHM -> SEMANTIC LAW -> MiniAndroid implementation path -> current divergence.

3. CRITICAL RESEARCH QUESTION — CAN WE REUSE INSTEAD OF REIMPLEMENT?

Investigate at least these reuse strategies:

A. Execute the APK's own Kotlin stdlib DEX correctly

Determine whether the current engine already has enough infrastructure that fixing generic:

- virtual/interface dispatch

- inherited method lookup

- descriptor-slot resolution

- property getter/setter dispatch

- collection copy semantics

- array/object/primitive kind preservation

- iterator contracts

could make most Kotlin stdlib work without a separate Kotlin backend.

This is the preferred hypothesis if source evidence supports it.

B. Reuse Kotlin/JVM stdlib source or compiled implementation

Investigate whether upstream Kotlin/JVM stdlib source or kotlin-stdlib.jar can be reused as a semantic reference/backend.

Do NOT simply execute host JVM objects in place of guest DEX objects unless object identity, class identity, field identity, generic dispatch, exceptions, and guest/host boundary semantics are proven equivalent.

Determine exactly what is reusable:

- source algorithms

- compiled bytecode

- Java collection delegation

- tests/conformance corpus

- selected helper algorithms

- generated/native helper code

C. Host Java/OpenJDK collection backend

Investigate whether Kotlin/JVM's Java collection paths delegate to java.util.* and whether MiniAndroid can safely reuse OpenJDK semantics for selected operations.

OpenJDK ArrayList.addAll is a useful reference, but do not blindly substitute host objects.

Required decision:

DIRECT REUSE / ADAPTER / SOURCE-PORT / CURRENT DEX EXECUTION / NOT SAFE.

D. Existing open-source JVM/DEX runtimes

Search GitHub for reusable execution engines/components:

- DEX interpreters

- Dalvik/ART-compatible interpreters

- JVM bytecode interpreters

- lightweight JVMs

- Kotlin/JVM runtime implementations

- Android compatibility runtimes

- collection/stdlib semantic test suites

Prioritize local/CPU/open-source/no-server/no-GPU projects.

Explicitly inspect relevant projects such as AndroidRecomp, DroidVM, Skydnir, droidsaw and any stronger DEX/JVM runtime you discover. Do not force unrelated projects into the solution: classify each as REUSABLE / REFERENCE-ONLY / IRRELEVANT.

E. Kotlin coroutines reuse

Separate this from collections.

Investigate whether kotlinx.coroutines source/compiled runtime can be executed unchanged by MiniAndroid once generic dispatch/thread/event-loop/continuation semantics are correct.

Do NOT replace coroutines with fake immediate execution.

4. BUILD A KOTLIN SEMANTIC COVERAGE MATRIX

Mine representative APKs and the current corpus.

At minimum classify:

- ArrayList

- ArrayDeque

- LinkedList

- HashMap

- LinkedHashMap

- HashSet

- LinkedHashSet

- Collections.unmodifiable/singleton/empty

- MutableCollection/MutableList defaults

- iterator/listIterator
